metadata.article_title: Where witness resides within Court’s jurisdiction.

article.title: Where witness resides within Court’s jurisdiction.
article.content: A commission for the examination of a person who resides within the local limits of the jurisdiction of the Court issuing the same may be issued to any person whom the Court thinks fit to execute it.
article.html:
3Where witness resides within Court’s jurisdiction.

Order 26, Rule 3

A commission for the examination of a person who resides within the local limits of the jurisdiction of the Court issuing the same may be issued to any person whom the Court thinks fit to execute it.
